dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, imagine you could have one superpower. What would it be?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪˈmædʒɪn juː kʊd ˈhæv ˈwʌn ˈsuːpərpaʊər. ˈwʌt wʊd ɪt ˈbiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Easy. I wish I could fly. Then I could visit you in Canada every weekend!
dialogue.reading: ˈiːzi. aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ kʊd ˈflaɪ. ˈðɛn aɪ kʊd ˈvɪzɪt juː ɪn ˈkænədə ˈɛvri ˈwiːkɛnd!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! I wish I could stop time. Then I wouldn't have to leave.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ kʊd ˈstɑːp ˈtaɪm. ˈðɛn aɪ ˈwʊdənt ˈhæf tə ˈliːv.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Or we could build a time machine and go back to the day we met.
dialogue.reading: ɔːr wiː kʊd ˈbɪld ə ˈtaɪm məˌʃiːn ənd ˈɡoʊ ˈbæk tə ðə ˈdeɪ wiː ˈmɛt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I read too many fantasy novels.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈriːd ˈtuː ˈmɛni ˈfæntəsi ˌnɑːvəlz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Me too. Sometimes I wish I could live in one of those worlds.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː. ˈsʌmtaɪmz aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ kʊd ˈlɪv ɪn ˈwʌn əv ðoʊz ˈwɜːrldz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not me. They're full of monsters!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt miː. ðɛr ˈfʊl əv ˈmɑːnstərz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, but in real life, what do you wish you could do?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, bʌt ɪn ˈriːəl ˈlaɪf, ˈwʌt duː juː ˈwɪʃ juː kʊd ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I wish I could speak English as well as you. My grammar isn't perfect.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ kʊd ˈspiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ əz ˈwɛl əz juː. maɪ ˈɡræmər ˈɪzənt ˈpɜːrfɪkt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Your English is great, Nam! I wish I could speak Thai as well as you speak English.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈɡreɪt, ˈnɑːm! aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ kʊd ˈspiːk ˈtaɪ əz ˈwɛl əz juː ˈspiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.
